scope: prospective-backtest truthfulness, active model and dataset provenance, read-only feature diagnostics, finite transformed evidence, feature-contract reconciliation, insufficient-observation handling, non-actionable heuristic language, optimization endpoint boundaries, source immutability, and predictive cross-compatibility
confirmed_findings_fixed: Every API request constructed a new untrained MLEngine and separate database reader, so diagnostics could be silently unavailable or detached from the activated runtime model and dataset; product routes now supply the active runtime snapshot and model and enforce the shared predictive provenance boundary.

Model Lab construction implicitly initialized persistent storage and predictive dependencies even when only the unavailable-backtest explanation was requested; default construction is now side-effect-free and reports missing evidence without creating a model or database.
Feature diagnostics could label undefined single-row variance as stable; insufficient observations are now explicit and receive no reassuring heuristic score.
Transformed feature matrices, importance outputs and model feature names were not reconciled or checked for finite values at the diagnostic boundary; incompatible evidence now fails closed.

The refinement plan could recommend pruning or removing features based only on arbitrary variance and correlation deductions; output now creates a review queue, applies no changes, promises no accuracy lift and requires independent evaluation.
Diagnostic analysis now works on defensive copies so the supplied active snapshot remains unchanged.
interpretation_boundary: Model Lab exposes descriptive variance, correlation and importance diagnostics for an already activated retrospective model. Its compatibility field named reliability is a heuristic index, not measurement reliability, model accuracy, future-departure validation or authority to change features.
remaining_scientific_limits: Prospective backtesting remains unavailable until predictions are timestamped before outcomes, a fixed outcome horizon matures and evaluation is performed without temporal leakage.
Variance, pairwise correlation and tree importance do not establish construct validity, causal relevance, subgroup stability or an accuracy improvement.
No automated retraining, pruning, threshold selection or activation is within Model Lab's reviewed scope.
Organization-specific temporal validation and independent review remain required before predictive claims can be strengthened.
release_gate: Local focused and full cross-product contracts are clean. Remote CI, independent review and explicit owner authorization remain pending.
